status: structural proposed state; no frozen reference mutation
purpose: Pin V2, restored V4, and clean-sheet/V-next to explicit roles so learner-facing presentation can be rebuilt without losing the 143-course evidence corpus or confusing experiments with source truth.

v4_live.mutable: only through normal Crew Blueprint governance

version_role_resolution.knowledge_truth: research/matrix logical tables and canonical Crew Blueprint content/history, not any single UI version
version_role_resolution.course_identity: canonical course IDs; historical route/body variants remain lineage/provenance
version_role_resolution.learner_shell: V4/current implementation may adopt clean-sheet strengths without inheriting clean-sheet's stagehand-first ontology
version_role_resolution.historical_retention: V2 and clean-sheet stay frozen; materially distinct course bodies stay in content/archive
version_role_resolution.current_market_truth: Production Atlas owning branch/data; never V2/V4 prose snapshots

crosswalk_rules: Do not select V2, V4, or clean-sheet wholesale as the knowledge source.
A V4 lesson must resolve to canonical CONTENT/COMPETENCY/SOURCE lineage before it is treated as evidence-backed.
Clean-sheet programs are presentation bundles and may map to many V2 course/content identities.
V2 course identities remain lineage keys even when their learner presentation is merged, hidden, or context-triggered.
Stagehand/general production is a lane, not a universal prerequisite ontology.
Rigging, production power, automation, special effects, work-at-height and similar controlled domains remain awareness/system-literacy unless external qualification/authorization applies.
Current V4 course surfaces do not silently redefine the proposed career-lane taxonomy.
No frozen reference is rewritten by this crosswalk.

front_door_resolution.rule: V4's Shop / Logistics course is a current learner-facing foundation/parallel-production surface. That presentation does not, by itself, amend PR #57's proposed six initial career entries. Any later front-door lane expansion remains an explicit architecture decision after acceptance of the mapped graph.

acceptance_checks: 143 canonical IDs remain accounted for exactly once in the primary mapping.
No historically unique body is deleted or silently overwritten.
Every V4 learner-facing claim resolves to a canonical content/claim state or is explicitly labeled presentation framing.
Version-specific routes are presentation/compatibility metadata, not new knowledge identities.
Production Atlas and Roadmapdev data remain domain-owned.
Current V4 presentation surfaces do not silently alter the proposed career-lane taxonomy.
